entity.description: A file of an employment: a contract, a letter, an identity or right-to-work document (IronStone People design §13 RecordFiles, PE-01; impl-people P2). The employment is People's content host, keyed by its partyRelationshipId, so an HR file is never on the person's broadly visible Party record; get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles admit it only to a People HR reader of the employer (mantle.humanres.PeopleServices.check#EmploymentAccess), and it has no Records-drive folder, so nothing shares it. Written through mantle.humanres.PeopleServices.create#EmploymentContent.

A dated assignment inside an employment (IronStone People design §4, PE-02; impl-people P6): the department, primary position, manager, work location and working schedule (P9) of the employment from fromDate until thruDate, and its state (working, or on a leave of absence). A transfer, a manager change or a leave ends the assignment in effect and starts the next, so history is kept and the payroll identity (the employment) is not split; one primary assignment at a time, inside the employment's dates. The assignment is the source of the employment's manager (per employment: a person employed by two employers has a manager at each), its department membership (a dated PrtMember row from role Assignee to the department) and its position occupancy (a dated EmplPositionParty row), which mantle.humanres.PeopleServices hire#Employee and apply#EmploymentChange keep as projections in the same transaction; the reporting line is a PrtManager row from the manager to the person. partyId and organizationPartyId are the employment's, kept here for the reads by person and employer. Written only by PeopleServices (Employment.js) and OrganizationServices (a manager change, a unit's closure).

entity.description: A hire or a dated change of an employment (IronStone People design §4 HireEmployee and EmploymentChange, PE-02; impl-people P6), a fact of its own: what changes (a transfer, a manager change, a leave of absence, a separation), from when, the new terms (with the working schedule, P9), why, who asked and when, the operation key a retry answers with, and its state. A transfer and a separation wait for approval (a PeopleApproval of kind PakEmploymentChange, bound to this row and the employment's revision, so a change of the employment meanwhile supersedes it) and are applied by the last approval; a hire, a manager change and a leave of absence are applied at once. Applied, the change has started the assignment employmentAssignmentId (a separation ends the employment's). P23: a pay change (payroll's part of a change: a new salary from the date, asked by a payroll editor) waits for approval too (its own kind, PakPayChange, the first salary included), and once applied has started the EmploymentSalary row from its date; its salary fields are read only by a payroll reader of the employer and the approver of its step. Written only by PeopleServices (Employment.js).

entity.description: An unfinished hire or employment change of one HR user (IronStone People's HireEmployee and EmploymentChange wizards; style-guide §3.10: a wizard that can be abandoned saves a draft record; the user's call, Nov 11): what the wizard's steps have taken so far (draftJson, the parameters of preview#Hire or preview#EmploymentChange only), from fromDate, with the operation key its hire or change is made with, so a retry answers the first. Owned by its user (userId): only they read, change or discard it (mantle.humanres.PeopleServices get#, store# and delete#EmploymentDraft, Employment.js), and it is discarded when the hire or change is made. A change's draft is of one employment and kind; a hire's of an employer. Not a business record: never read by another user, an export or a search.

A file is shared with the interview panel (panelShared Y): a resume when attached (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026, P17; the recruiter can stop sharing it), another file once a recruiter shares it; a panel member reads the shared files of the applications they interview, and no other (get#ApplicationFile).

entity.description: A letter People issued (design §15 "Employment/offer and lifecycle letters"; impl-people P17): an offer's (employmentOfferId) or the lifecycle letter of an applied employment change (employmentChangeId: a hire's confirmation, a transfer, a manager change, a leave of absence, a return, a separation), rendered once from People's letter template (Letters.js) when issued and stored (contentLocation: its PDF, or its html-print page where the server has no PDF engine), then read from storage and never rendered again. includesPay Y: it holds pay terms, read only with PAYROLL_VIEW. One letter per offer or change; read by the services of its record (RecruitingServices.get#OfferLetter, PeopleServices.get#EmploymentLetter), never a public link. An issued offer's letter is emailed to the applicant (send#OfferLetter); the person a lifecycle letter is addressed to reads it whole in their self-service (PeopleServices find#MyLetters and get#MyLetter: the user's call of Nov 12, 2026, P17 review).
